name: Summertime

waypoints.name: Highway 20 pullout near Mazama (below Spires Gully)
waypoints.note: Roadside pullout; ~20-25 min approach crossing Early Winters Creek.
waypoints.directions: Coming from Winthrop, drive west on SR-20 through Mazama toward Washington Pass; from the Seattle side, continue over Washington Pass and down toward Mazama. Park at a small pullout on the east side of the highway, just before the larger Spires Gully parking area used to reach the Early Winters Spires from the east. It is a pull-off rather than a signed trailhead, so use the Spires Gully lot as your landmark and stop just short of it. The walk in is only 20 to 25 minutes with little elevation change.

descent_text: The descent beyond the crux pitch is unknown; anchors/chains are passed at several points along the route, suggesting parties can lower/rappel pitch-by-pitch from these, or continue to the top. Confirm current beta before committing to the full 5-pitch line.
